content_text: Bounce lighting is spatial, it doesn’t have the precision of direct light, give it room… To control it, it needs larger cutters closer to the subject yet staying out of the action of the scene. Bounced light while close to your subject is at its “softest”…. as you you move it away from your subject it becomes more directional (which that manages its distribution) . That is a consideration for the control of your lighting.
